## Safety Checklist

- [ ] Uses official APIs only for external platform integration.
- [ ] Does not add scraping, stealth automation, CAPTCHA bypass, anti-detection behavior, or UI-based posting.
- [ ] Does not commit raw tokens, cookies, API keys, credential files, local vaults, or generated private media.
- [ ] Keeps private automation plugins separate from open-source Core.
- [ ] Keeps publish actions auditable.
- [ ] Keeps auto-publish opt-in only.
- [ ] Updates docs when behavior changes.

## Notes For Reviewers

Call out migrations, API changes, plugin permission changes, security implications, or known follow-ups.
